additional_context: The current combined branch includes 3b38b80cf2, which removed Transport from active source/fhir.ini resource entries along with other immature OO resources. source/ballot-intro.html points Transport to the HL7 OO incubator IG, whose continuous build is based on HL7/oo-incubator.
reconciliation: No source change was made in core. The remaining source/transport files are inactive residual source, so editing them would not change the current FHIR core build.
